subject: Deployment path clarity & sandbox onramp — ClearWave quick answers
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Swartz <alice.swartz@clearwavetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment path clarity & sandbox onramp — ClearWave quick answers

Hi Alice — thanks again for the demo earlier. High-level recap and a few quick qualification items so we can recommend the best onramp (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

1) What we heard in the call
- Primary use: conversational assistant + structured summarization for customer support.
- Data sensitivity: some PII, a small subset of records subject to contractual residency constraints.
- Success metric: sub-200ms 95p latency on short-turn queries, and predictable cost under $X/month once built.

2) Questions for you (short answers are fine):
- Expected monthly generation tokens (approx)?
- Peak concurrent requests / RPS during business hours?
- Do you require data to remain in a specific region or need a dedicated tenancy (contractual requirement) vs. a hosted instance?
- Any mandatory compliance needs beyond SOC 2 (e.g., HIPAA, FedRAMP)?

3) What we can offer for the pilot
- Hosted API quickstart: sandbox endpoints, a temporary quota for testing prefix caching and KV-backed sessions, and access to our streaming SDK. Good for fastest time-to-value.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool if you need sustained high throughput and tenancy isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full private control plane where customer manages networking; recommended if you have strict residency or air-gapped requirements.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (summary), ClearWave_MAP_draft.xlsx (mutual action plan template).

Next steps proposal:
- Please reply with the 4 quick answers above by EOD tomorrow — that will let us recommend a short-run pilot configuration.
- If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min technical follow-up with Ben (in cc) to walk your infra/security lead through the sandbox endpoints and rate-limit behaviour.
- I'll also share a short security questionnaire link if you want to loop in security now.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

---
Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (1.2MB, PDF), ClearWave_MAP_draft.xlsx (12KB, XLSX)

From: Alice Swartz <alice.swartz@clearwavetech.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@clearwavetech.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment path clarity & sandbox onramp — ClearWave quick answers

Thanks Mateo — great recap. Quick answers below: 

- Monthly generation tokens: ballpark 80M–120M tokens/month to start (growth expected as we enable more flows).
- Peak RPS: roughly 60 concurrent requests (spikes to ~120 for short windows during campaign launches).
- Residency/tenancy: we need EU data residency for EU customers; US data can remain in hosted. No immediate requirement for full dedicated tenancy, but we need predictable isolation during peak windows.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is the main ask today; evaluating HIPAA for later pilots.

We'd like to try the Hosted sandbox first to validate latency and cost profile. Mark (cc) is our infra/security lead — he may want to review the SOC2 summary and the security questionnaire. Please add Ben to the follow-up for technical parity on rate-limits and KV/prefix caching behaviour.

Also: can you confirm the sandbox rate limit profile (requests/sec per endpoint) and whether we can test a sustained run for a few hours (not just short bursts)?

Best,
Alice
Alice Swartz
Head of Product | ClearWave Labs
alice.swartz@clearwavetech.com

Alice — perfect, thanks for the quick answers. This helps a lot. A few clarifications and immediate actions: 

- Hosted sandbox rate limits: default sandbox profile is 50 RPS per logical endpoint, with a per-account burst window up to 150 RPS for short tests. We can provision a sustained test window (2–4 hours) at ~120 RPS for your pilot if you want to validate concurrency behaviour; Ben will coordinate scheduling.
- Residency: since you need EU residency for EU traffic, recommended approach is hybrid routing — Host EU customer traffic to our EU-hosted endpoints and US traffic to our US-hosted endpoints. If you later need contract-level tenancy or air-gapped controls we can discuss Dedicated or Private options.
- SOC2 / security: attaching the SOC2 summary should be fine for initial review. I'll send the security questionnaire link (one-click form) so Mark can populate the answers.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben and I run a 30-min infra call with Mark this week to set up the sandbox sustained-run (I added a Calendly link in related_links).
2) ClearWave fills the short security questionnaire — Ben will review answers and flag any gating items.
3) We run the sustained sandbox at the requested profile and capture latency & cost telemetry; we’ll map those results to a recommendation (Hosted quickstart vs Dedicated).

If that plan looks good I'll lock in a time (Ben prefers mornings PST). Thanks — looking forward.

Regards,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
